With this subscription, I am able to include a cross-site scripting payload in a QRCode and collect the admin’s cookie. This provides access to the Django admin panel where I’ll get a hash and SSH access to the box. Another user is running custom network monitoring software. I’ll exploit a buffer overflow in the IPv6 handler to get a shell as that user. That user has access to the Docker Registry, where I’ll find the image for the container running the Django site, including the hardcoded secret. I’ll exploit a deserialization vulnerability to get a root shell in that container.
